svg.title: A sync, through the server
svg.desc: Architecture of the Bearing server with a sync traced through it: a schedule or bearing source sync asks the API, which logs a request in the event log; the source's apply worker takes it in order and calls the adapter's Sync over gRPC; the adapter reads the source system and returns a page, which is logged and then ingested into the DuckDB store, the last page closing what the source stopped listing; the worker then signals the matcher, which writes identity links. Webhooks take the same path after the webhook route checks and logs them, and the CLI and MCP read asserted facts through the API.
